title: Betting on Bets: Anytime-Valid Tests for Stochastic Dominance
summary: How can we monitor, in real time, whether one uncertain prospect has any upside over another? To answer this question, we develop a novel family of sequential, anytime-valid tests for stochastic dominance (SD), a classical and popular notion for comparing entire distribution functions. The problem is distinct from that of testing mean dominance, and it is particularly useful when comparing distributions with similar means or with ordinal outcomes.
